name: Whistle Bear: trees the 2017 LiDAR has that the 2025 photo shows gone (EPSG:2958)

properties.note: conifer grove west of the central pond, stripped to bare soil between 2022-04-28 (Waterloo photo: intact) and 2025-04-07 (SWOOP 2025); a few trees remain at the NW corner (left out); the grove to the south still stands. To check against the detected trees after the first build.
properties.source: Phase 0 research, SWOOP 2020 / 2025 and Waterloo 2022 photos
